pdk: gf180mcuD (digital image /pdk/gf180mcuD for Magic/Netgen; analog image /foss/pdks/gf180mcuD models for ngspice)

safe.notes: Reset-default = every control input 0; clock/pad inputs toggling. Includes 3.63 V at 85 C (ff) and 0 C (ss).

drc.gds_export: analog image Magic 8.3.678, cif ostyle gdsii

observable.notes: Points exist as ports; register-file / test-bus / CLK_OBS mux codes are assigned at integration (register map not yet published).

fallback.notes: Wired PLL with the compact 8-phase ring.
